### 1 — Scene
A burger with shredded lettuce, tomato, pickle, dark sliced toppings that appear to be black olives, and three fried chicken-wing pieces.

### 2 — Vessel
A dinner plate, approximately **26 cm diameter**.  
Area = 3.14 × 13² = **531 cm²**.

### 3 — Items
Visible components appear to be a bread bun, cooked burger patty, lettuce, tomato, pickle, black olives, a little cheese and creamy dressing, plus fried chicken wings. The cheese and dressing identification is less certain.

### 4 — Area
Estimated **non-overlapping visible coverage**:

| Component | Plate area covered |
|---|---:|
| Bun | 22% |
| Chicken wings | 10% |
| Exposed patty | 1.5% |
| Lettuce | 2% |
| Tomato | 0.8% |
| Pickle | 1.5% |
| Black olives | 0.5% |
| Cheese | 0.4% |
| Dressing | 0.3% |
| **Total** | **39%** |

This leaves roughly 61% of the plate uncovered. Burger ingredients overlap; their full component footprints below therefore exceed their exposed areas above.

### 5–7 — Volume, weight and energy
For the burger layers, the footprint estimates include the portions extending beneath the bun. Density is the only volume-to-weight reduction applied.

| Item | Footprint × height = gross volume | Density (g/ml) | Estimated grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Bun, both halves | 117 cm² × 2.6 cm = 304 ml | 0.30 | 91 | 290 | 264 |
| Cooked beef patty | 85 cm² × 1.0 cm = 85 ml | 1.00 | 85 | 250 | 213 |
| Shredded lettuce | 50 cm² × 1.7 cm = 85 ml | 0.15 | 13 | 15 | 2 |
| Tomato | 40 cm² × 0.6 cm = 24 ml | 0.90 | 22 | 18 | 4 |
| Pickle slices | 28 cm² × 0.8 cm = 22 ml | 0.90 | 20 | 12 | 2 |
| Sliced black olives | 14 cm² × 1.0 cm = 14 ml | 0.65 | 9 | 115 | 10 |
| Cheese | 50 cm² × 0.2 cm = 10 ml | 1.00 | 10 | 400 | 40 |
| Creamy dressing | 16 cm² × 0.5 cm = 8 ml | 1.00 | 8 | 650 | 52 |
| Fried chicken wings | 53 cm² × 2.2 cm = 117 ml | 0.90 | 105 | 230 | 242 |

The wings’ weight includes bones; their energy density is adjusted accordingly. Frying oil is included in the wings’ energy estimate, not counted separately.

### 8 — Sanity check
**Approximately 463 g and 830 kcal** is plausible for this substantial burger and three small bone-in wing pieces. A reasonable visual-estimate uncertainty is about ±25%, especially for the patty, dressing and wings.
